'''Fhentar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and a [[Chosen (Ki Sazen)|Chosen]] of the [[Cult of Ki Sazen|Nikto cult]] that worshipped the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ki Sazen]].
